'''2008 World Championship''' was the 13th Star Wars CCG World Championship, run by the [[Players Committee]] at Twin City Comics in Columbia Heights, in the Minneapolis area of Minnesota, on 9–12 October 2008.<ref name="pc-sid86" /><ref name="pc-sid98" /> The Committee announced the site on 28 May 2008; the host was [[Garrett Larson]].<ref name="pc-sid86" /> In his proposal Larson reported that Jay, the owner of Twin City Comics, would charge little or nothing for the space, which had comfortably hosted tournaments of over 40 players and would not get tight until over 60; Larson also offered to arrange a discounted block of rooms at a nearby hotel and to host a few players at his house.<ref name="pc-sid86" /> The nearest airport was Minneapolis–St. Paul International, and the store was across the street from the Columbia Heights Transit station of the Metro Transit bus service.<ref name="pc-sid86" /> Some players flew in on the Friday morning, among them [[Jonathan Murray]] and [[Casey Anis]], and asked for rides from the airport to the store; [[Garrett Larson]] suggested the train into downtown and then a bus to the store.<ref name="pcf-23233-336782">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=336782#336782 anyone up for a little drive?!], Jonathan Murray (Throdo), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (18 September 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080919091030/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=336792&sid=1211bbf40dcb863be90b6a41acc80db5 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-23233-336792">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=336792#336792 anyone up for a little drive?!], Garrett Larson (deadbody), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (18 September 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080919091030/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=336792&sid=1211bbf40dcb863be90b6a41acc80db5 Internet Archive]</ref> The announcement thanked Larson, Henry and the Tournament Committee.<ref name="pc-sid86" /> The constructed pool was [[Premiere - Original VS16]].<ref name="awards" /><ref name="tdl" /> 60 players took part.<ref name="wp" /> Player ratings were to be implemented starting with this event.<ref name="pc-news7">[http://www.swccgpc.com/news/news.php?id=7 10 Questions with Scott Lingrell], swccgpc.com (8 October 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081009225918/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/news/news.php?id=7 Internet Archive]</ref> [[Kevin Shannon]] defeated [[Kyle Krueger]] in the final, playing Ralltiir Operations and Dantooine Base Operations on Day 3; Krueger had reached the final as the eighth seed.<ref name="awards" /><ref name="f75427-1300387">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1300387#p1300387 Post by Yoshi], "SWCCG Worlds Day 3 Standings History", forum.starwarsccg.org (28 May 2020). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012152200/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t75427.html#p1300387 Internet Archive]</ref> [[Justin Desai]]'s team, the [[Kashyyyk Train of Dominance]], won the team championship for the second year running.<ref name="awards" /> The Day 1, Day 2, Day 3 and Team decklists were published as PDFs; the sheets are dated 10 October (Day 1), 11 October (Day 2) and 12 October 2008 (Day 3).<ref name="tdl" /> [[Tim Simon]] scanned the decklist sheets, which [[Garrett Larson]] had sent him, and posted them on the Players Committee forum in November 2008, aiming to have them all up by Thanksgiving; the Day 2 lists went up as a single PDF, and on 26 November 2008 he posted the last Day 3 lists, writing that "everything played at Worlds 2008 should be represented now".<ref name="pcf-24244-355330">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=355330#355330 WORLDS 2008 DECKLISTS], Tim Simon (Aglets), quoted by staffpmc, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (1 December 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081207045343/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=355335&sid=da800f192a94d4e0badb0ea8628c4ff7 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-24244-354213">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=354213#354213 WORLDS 2008 DECKLISTS], Joe Olson (arebelspy), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (26 November 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081207045343/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=355335&sid=da800f192a94d4e0badb0ea8628c4ff7 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-24244-354357">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=354357#354357 WORLDS 2008 DECKLISTS], Tim Simon (Aglets), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (26 November 2008). === Schedule and prizes ===

The Players Committee's schedule (6 September 2008):<ref name="pc-sid98" />

* Thursday 9 October: Day 0 Cube qualifier (six games, each side three times, two drafts; 45-minute rounds); the two best Swiss scores received Day 2 bids.
* Friday 10 October: Day 1 ($40; open constructed, six games of Swiss, top 50% to Day 2, minimum 4), open to players without an automatic Day 2 bid; and the Worlds Team Tournament.
* Saturday 11 October: Day 2 (eight games; top 8 to Day 3) and the Worlds Consolation Tournament.
* Sunday 12 October: Day 3, match play; the higher seed chose the first side, games were timed at 1 hour 15 minutes, timed wins scored the same victory points as full wins, and the top 2 advanced to the final confrontation.

Entry fees were $10 for the Day 0 Cube qualifier, $40 for Day 1, $20 for the Worlds Team Tournament, $40 for Day 2 (waived for players advancing from Day 1) and $10 for the Saturday Consolation Tournament. SWCCGPC premium members received $3 off the Cube qualifier and the Saturday Consolation Tournament and $5 off Day 1, the Team Tournament and Day 2.<ref name="pc-sid98" />

=== Byes passed down from the MPC ===

In August 2008 players on the PC forum were unsure what had happened to the Worlds bye passed down from the 2008 Match Play Championship. [[Kyle Krueger]] thought the decision had been not to give it to anyone, while a top-8 player posting as Mr. Pink, who had not yet qualified, said forum opinion had been to give it to all three unqualified top-8 players and asked where the decision had been posted.<ref name="pcf-22582-330067">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=330067#330067 Round 1 Bye], Joe Olson (arebelspy), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (22 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080903083612/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=330718 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-22582-330232">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=330232#330232 Round 1 Bye], Kyle Krueger (Meto), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (22 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080903083612/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=330718 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-22582-330261">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=330261#330261 Round 1 Bye], Mr. Pink, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (22 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080903083612/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=330718 Internet Archive]</ref> Asked whether the two Day 2 byes from the Worlds Consolation event gave [[Patrick Johnson|Pat Johnson]] a bye, a player posting as simone89 answered that he and "R Smith" held them; retwin316 replied that only Reid was listed on the byes list.<ref name="pcf-22582-331330">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=331330#331330 Round 1 Bye], retwin316, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (27 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080903083612/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=330718 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-22582-332137">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=332137#332137 Round 1 Bye], simone89, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (29 August 2008). == Side events ==

Besides the team tournament, the schedule had a Day 0 Cube qualifier on 9 October (two Day 2 bids), a Worlds Mini-Open booster draft on 10 October (Reflections I, Cloud City and OTSD packs; four games playing the side drafted; the top Light and Dark players advanced to Day 2) and a six-game constructed Worlds Consolation Tournament on 11 October, whose top two received automatic bids to the 2009 World Championships.<ref name="pc-sid98" /><ref name="pc-events0810">[https://web.archive.org/web/20081024183452/http://swccgpc.com:80/events/ Events (October 2008)], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 24 October 2008.</ref> A second six-game constructed Worlds Consolation Tournament was scheduled for Sunday 12 October ($20 entry, $5 off for premium members); first place paid $155 and second place $105, each with an automatic bid to the [[2009 World Championship|2009 World Championships]].<ref name="pc-sid98" /> No results of these events have been found.

=== Team tournament ===

Teams were two players, each assigned one side, and played four rounds of open constructed; prizes included automatic Day 2 bids.<ref name="pc-sid98" /> The [[Kashyyyk Train of Dominance]], [[Justin Desai]]'s team, won the 2008 Worlds team championship.<ref name="awards" />

=== Fantasy Worlds ===

Players on the PC forum again ran a "Fantasy Worlds" game, in which entrants picked a team of three to five players worth up to 100 points in total and scored the sum of their three best finishes, lowest score winning.<ref name="pcf-23038-334983">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=334983#334983 fantasy worlds?], Brad Eier, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (9 September 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080917023619/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=334563&sid=912dbcd1b9a9804d893f1227e76d8edc Internet Archive]</ref> A player posting as WiseMarsellus set the point values on 16 September 2008: [[Justin Desai]] 50; [[Jonny Chu|Jon Chu]] 45; [[Brian Hunter]] 40; [[Brian Fred]], [[Mike Gemme]], [[Steve Baroni]] and [[Kevin Shannon]] 35; [[Tom Hollingworth]] 30; other named players 15 to 25; and all others 10.<ref name="pcf-23038-336451">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=336451#336451 fantasy worlds?], WiseMarsellus, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (16 September 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080917023619/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=334563&sid=912dbcd1b9a9804d893f1227e76d8edc Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-23038-336467">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=336467#336467 fantasy worlds?], WiseMarsellus, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (16 September 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080917023619/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=334563&sid=912dbcd1b9a9804d893f1227e76d8edc Internet Archive]</ref>

== Coverage ==

On 8 October 2008 the Players Committee asked blog owners attending the event to post constant reports of matchups, events and funny happenings, which site admins could promote into a streaming front-page news feed on Worlds.<ref name="pc-news8">[http://www.swccgpc.com/news/news.php?id=8 Worlds Blog Coverage!], swccgpc.com (8 October 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081009225924/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/news/news.php?id=8 Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee forum had a World Championships board, where players asked in October 2008 for news, results and decklists from the event.<ref name="pcf-23633-342551">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=342551#342551 threads about worlds?], Tusken84, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 October 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081021233940/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=342626&sid=198be8cdf7bda3b05cc740ccf203ad9f Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-23633-342626">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=342626#342626 threads about worlds?], AnakinSolo, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 October 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081021233940/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=342626&sid=198be8cdf7bda3b05cc740ccf203ad9f Internet Archive]</ref>
